remove_hint: Remove the downloaded recorder? Your videos and preferences are preserved.
storage_hint: Existing videos remain in their current folders.
replay_launch: Start replay when I click Play
duration_hint: Duration changes apply the next time replay starts.
launch_hint: The portal may ask which screen or window to capture. Closing this panel keeps the capture running.
presets_hint: Presets use constant quality and select an available hardware codec. Adjust manually below.
audio_hint: Game audio follows the launched process. Device availability depends on the installed recorder.
shortcuts_hint: Shortcuts work inside games with the PeliGames overlay enabled. Reopen the game after changing bindings.
no_videos: No videos saved for this game.
title: Video title
how_text: Prepare the component, choose video and audio settings, then start recording or replay. Save replay writes the buffered seconds to a video. Stop capture finishes the current recording. Automatic replay starts only when you launch the game.
settings_hint: Settings are saved automatically. Video and audio changes apply to the next capture.
prepare_first: Download the recorder in Manage before starting a capture.
other_game: Another game is being captured. Stop that capture before starting this one.
bridge_missing: The game launch information is unavailable.
runtime_hint: Download the portable recorder without root. Removing this package does not delete videos.
